normalisation.scheme: per-pair per-band z-score, pooled over both dates
normalisation.partition: TRAIN only, inside the training windows
normalisation.counting: each unique geographic coordinate once per date
normalisation.registration: date 2 read through the same loader as the patches
normalisation.note: aligns per-band first and second moments with the training domain; does not equalise higher moments, spatial correlation or the per-date radiometric offset
